issue: GEM holds all three units (T1/T2/T3) as Status=construction, with the newest citation dated January 2024 (S&P Global interview) and Status [ref] itself an oilprice.com piece from September 2023 (~50% complete claim). No independent source found reporting on this specific project (Tombak Port / Asaluyeh, Bushehr Province) since Jan 2024 -- over two years of no fresh confirmation either way. Meanwhile the exact host region has been an active war zone since 18 March 2026: Israeli/US strikes hit the Asaluyeh gas-treatment complex (which processes South Pars phases 3-6 feedgas, the same feedgas source the LNG project depends on) and South Pars gas field itself, taking roughly 12% of Iran's gas production offline; fighting/strikes in the Strait of Hormuz region were still ongoing as of 13 July 2026 (post an 8 April ceasefire that did not hold). No source located explicitly states the NIOC LNG plant/construction site itself was struck, damaged, halted, or conversely that work has continued or resumed since the war began -- extensive searching (Reuters/Argus/S&P Global/Shana/Iran Intl/oilprice/CGEP/Gas Outlook/IEEFA/Wikipedia) turned up nothing project-specific post-Jan 2024. The read-only Postgres timeline (fetch_timeline.py, unit G100002058301) shows only proposed(2005) -> construction actual(2023) -> operating planned(2025) -- the 2025 entry is a planned/target milestone only, not a confirmed operating date, and start did not visibly occur (no source found announcing first LNG / commissioning). Given the substantial war-related disruption to the exact feedgas source and immediately adjacent processing infrastructure, plus the total absence of any fresh (2025-2026) confirmation that construction is ongoing, 'construction' can no longer be affirmatively verified as current -- but there is also no confirmed report of a shelved/mothballed/cancelled status. This is a genuine verification gap, not a confirmed status change, so per the never-punt rule no Status/timeline edit is being staged.
suggested_action: Reviewer should check Iranian oil-ministry (Shana/shana.ir) statements, NIOC press releases, and any post-April-2026-ceasefire energy-sector damage assessments (e.g. satellite-imagery services, IEA/EIA Iran updates, HRW's targeting-of-energy-infrastructure tracking) specifically for the Tombak/Asaluyeh LNG plant. If a credible source confirms the project was damaged/halted, stage Status=shelved or mothballed with anchor year + timeline entry per never-punt; if a source confirms construction is continuing/resumed, refresh Status [ref] to a post-war citation. Until then, leave Status=construction as-is (unverified but not disproven) and flag on next review cycle -- do not let this go another cycle without a fresh check given the war context.
